rubric_scale.1: Unsatisfactory: Lacks basic conceptual understanding, cannot explain fundamental terms, offers incorrect or misleading explanations.
rubric_scale.2: Basic / Developing: Superficial knowledge of terminology, struggles to apply concepts to practical scenarios, misses key constraints.
rubric_scale.3: Competent / Solid: Solid grasp of core concepts, provides accurate explanations, demonstrates practical coding and debugging logic.
rubric_scale.4: Advanced / Strong: Deep technical comprehension, discusses trade-offs proactively, references best practices and production edge cases.
rubric_scale.5: Exceptional / Expert: Outstanding mastery, connects theory to high-scale architecture, articulates nuanced trade-offs, shows engineering leadership.

behavioral_competencies.name: Problem Solving & Technical Agility
behavioral_competencies.definition: Ability to dissect complex, ambiguous problems, debug methodically, and absorb unfamiliar technologies swiftly.
behavioral_competencies.star_guidelines: Look for logical root-cause analysis, use of telemetry/logs, structured experimentation, and tangible lessons learned.

behavioral_competencies.name: Collaboration & Team Communication
behavioral_competencies.definition: Working effectively with peers, resolving technical disagreements constructively, and communicating complex ideas clearly.
behavioral_competencies.star_guidelines: Look for active listening, willingness to build consensus through data/benchmarks, and respect for teammates.

behavioral_competencies.name: Ownership & Accountability
behavioral_competencies.definition: Taking end-to-end responsibility for deliverables, meeting commitments, and proactively unblocking blockers.
behavioral_competencies.star_guidelines: Look for self-initiative, early communication of risks, and commitment to code quality and testing.

behavioral_competencies.name: Learning Agility & Curiosity
behavioral_competencies.definition: Intrinsic drive to explore emerging tools, read documentation, and expand engineering horizons.
behavioral_competencies.star_guidelines: Look for self-directed side projects, curiosity about inner mechanics, and rapid uptake of feedback.

behavioral_competencies.name: Adaptability & Resilience
behavioral_competencies.definition: Gracefully pivoting when project requirements shift, handling constructive feedback, and recovering from failures.
behavioral_competencies.star_guidelines: Look for calm problem re-scoping, modular code adaptability, and a growth mindset.
